items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I explained to the boss, Mr. Shaw, that my mother had found out I was working up there

ctx.x: gosh. He went back and told it was a sporting house that they were doing everything up there. So, my mother came back. She dressed and came back up there. And while he was gone, I explained to the boss, Mr. Shaw, that my mother had found out I was working up there and that she was coming to start some trouble. And he said, don't worry, don't worry, I'll fix everything. So, when she came in, I went by, he said, you give me a sign when she gets to the door. So, when she came to the door, I gave him a sign, you…
And I said, she was getting proud of me.
